༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pa)pa'i dkar chag/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (pa)pa'i dkar chag /

ka phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gtor dbang yid bzhin nor bu/ kha phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi gsol 'debs/ ga phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi man ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ nga phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len rgyun 'khyer 'khrul med snying po/ ca phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi ngag 'don byin rlabs dpal 'bar/ cha phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi nyams len mdor bsdus ngag bsgrigs/ ja zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus/ nya nā ro'i chos drug gi rtogs pa don gyi brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig nyung ngur byas pa/ ta zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi bka' bab nyams dang rtogs pa byin rlabs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i lang tsho/ tha chos drug dril ba'i gdams pa/ da zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa nā ro zhabs kyi zhal gyi lung bzang po/ na 'khrul snang du dpal nā ro pas gnang ba'i tsaṇḍa lī dang 'pho ba zab pa/ pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi khrid yig rnam 'byed shing rta/ pha rim lnga dmar khrid kyi gsol 'debs/ ba dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi dmar khrid zab don nor bu'i phreng ba/ ma rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba/ tsa rgyab mdun rlung 'jug thur ma'i man ngag/ tsha myur lam 'pho ba'i gdams pa 'jag tshugs ma'i khrid yig padma can du bgrod pa'i pho nya/ dza ma bsgom par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'pho ba'i gdams pa mdor bsdus pa 'jag tshugs ma/ wa bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i yig chung gambhī ra/
